summary: The Slippy Penguin (calm: the Waddle Penguin), Pinecone Pass's new recurring chaos species for Milestone 69: a 2x2 body sheet (chaos idle, dizzy; the burst, belly-sliding with snow spray; soothed, flipper to its head; calm, waving), drawn to the owner's critter concept sheet's style.
generationSource: Generated with Gemini from the owner's critter concept sheet for the watercolour style, proportions, and swirly purple chaos eyes, and the vfx particles sheet for the fizz marks.

edits.prompt: A 2x2 character sheet of a NEW small cartoon animal character, drawn in exactly the style of the first reference image (the cozy critter concept sheet): the same soft watercolour painting with thin warm-brown ink outlines, the same friendly simple cartoon animal proportions, and the same size of figure in each of the four cells. The character is a round little penguin chick with a smooth blue-black back, a soft white belly, a tiny orange beak, and small orange feet. Top-left cell: the penguin standing dizzy and fizzy, its eyes swirly purple spirals, tiny purple fizz bubbles popping around it, flippers sticking out at odd angles. Top-right cell: bursting, belly-sliding fast, snow spray and purple bubbles flying behind it. Bottom-left cell: soothed, its swirly eyes drooping sleepy, one flipper rubbing its head, the fizz fading. Bottom-right cell: calm and friendly, standing tall with a warm smile, waving one flipper. Use a restrained cool pastel palette and absolutely no pink or magenta anywhere on the penguin; the plain background must be bright flat magenta (#FF00FF) filling every cell. No text, no labels, no shadows on the background, no faded copies, no extra figures, and every figure whole and uncropped inside its own cell.
edits.note: Rejected: the same textured-background web as the crab's first sheet; regenerated.

postProcessing.build: bun tools/art/build-person.ts penguin. The shared person builder keys magenta, drops detached islands under 120 px, despills the alpha edge, scales the chaos idle body to 380 px, and adds the shared hamster aura.

measuredCentres.bodyCentreMethod: mean opaque-pixel centroid across the four generated body frames

checker.bodyHueNote: Set from the measured frames: a penguin's body is mostly achromatic (white belly, blue-black back), so the bluebird's 0.3 in-range floor is wrong for it. The kept sheet's watercolour blue-gray washes measure hue ~0.6 at 19.6 percent of the body, and the 0.15 floor catches them while an all-white wrong-palette body would fail.
